"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Button } from "@/components/niko-table/primitives/button"
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/niko-table/primitives/dialog"
import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/niko-table/primitives/select"
import { UserPlus } from "lucide-react"
import { assignableRoles, type Member, type MemberRole } from "./team-data"

export type NewMember = Pick<Member, "name" | "email" | "role">

/** The "Invite member" button and its form, in one dialog. */
export function InviteMemberDialog({
  onInvite,
}: {
  onInvite: (member: NewMember) => void
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false)
  const [role, setRole] = React.useState<MemberRole>("member")

  function handleSubmit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault()
    const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget)
    onInvite({
      name: String(form.get("name")).trim(),
      email: String(form.get("email")).trim(),
      role,
    })
    event.currentTarget.reset()
    setRole("member")
    setOpen(false)
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button size="sm">
          <UserPlus className="size-4" aria-hidden="true" />
          Invite member
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Invite a member</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            They get an email with a link to join.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form id="invite-member" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <FieldGroup>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="invite-name">Name</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id="invite-name"
                name="name"
                required
                autoComplete="off"
                placeholder="Jordan Park"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="invite-email">Work email</FieldLabel>
              <Input
                id="invite-email"
                name="email"
                type="email"
                required
                autoComplete="off"
                placeholder="jordan@example.com"
              />
            </Field>
            <Field>
              <FieldLabel htmlFor="invite-role">Role</FieldLabel>
              <Select
                value={role}
                onValueChange={(value: string | null) =>
                  value && setRole(value as MemberRole)
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger id="invite-role" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {assignableRoles.map(option => (
                    <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                      {option.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </Field>
          </FieldGroup>
        </form>
        <DialogFooter>
          <DialogClose asChild>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
              Cancel
            </Button>
          </DialogClose>
          <Button type="submit" form="invite-member" size="sm">
            Send invite
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  )
}

export type MemberRole = "owner" | "admin" | "member" | "viewer"
export type MemberStatus = "active" | "invited" | "suspended"

export type Member = {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: MemberRole
  status: MemberStatus
  teams: string[]
  /** Null while the invite is pending. */
  lastActive: Date | null
  twoFactor: boolean
  /** When they joined, or were invited. */
  joinedAt: Date
}

/** Fixed "now" for the sample data, so relative times never drift. */
export const NOW = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 2, 15, 0))

export const roleOptions = [
  { label: "Owner", value: "owner" },
  { label: "Admin", value: "admin" },
  { label: "Member", value: "member" },
  { label: "Viewer", value: "viewer" },
]

/** Roles you can hand out. There is exactly one owner. */
export const assignableRoles = roleOptions.filter(
  option => option.value !== "owner",
)

export const statusOptions = [
  { label: "Active", value: "active" },
  { label: "Invited", value: "invited" },
  { label: "Suspended", value: "suspended" },
]

export const teamNames = ["Design", "Platform", "Growth", "Support"]

/**
 * Sample data, generated rather than hand-written. A seeded PRNG (mulberry32)
 * keeps it random-looking but identical on every render. Swap `members` for
 * your own rows.
 */
function seededRandom(seed: number) {
  let a = seed
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
  }
}

const firstNames = [
  "Alma",
  "Ben",
  "Carmen",
  "Dmitri",
  "Esi",
  "Felix",
  "Gwen",
  "Hiro",
  "Isla",
  "Jalen",
  "Kira",
  "Luca",
  "Marta",
  "Noor",
  "Otto",
  "Priya",
]
const lastNames = [
  "Andersen",
  "Bauer",
  "Chowdhury",
  "Dlamini",
  "Engel",
  "Ferreira",
  "Gallo",
  "Hayes",
  "Ivanova",
  "Joshi",
  "Kovac",
  "Lam",
  "Mensah",
  "Nolan",
  "Ortiz",
  "Park",
]

const DAY = 86_400_000

// Fixed positions (never 0, the owner) so the mix is guaranteed.
const invitedAt = [5, 12, 21]
const suspendedAt = [8, 26]

function generateMembers(count: number, seed: number): Member[] {
  const random = seededRandom(seed)
  const pick = <T>(items: readonly T[]) =>
    items[Math.floor(random() * items.length)] as T
  const used = new Set<string>()

  const people = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    let name: string
    do {
      name = `${pick(firstNames)} ${pick(lastNames)}`
    } while (used.has(name))
    used.add(name)

    const roleRoll = random()
    const role: MemberRole =
      i === 0
        ? "owner"
        : roleRoll < 0.12
          ? "admin"
          : roleRoll < 0.35
            ? "viewer"
            : "member"
    // Most are active; a few pending invites and suspensions.
    const status: MemberStatus = invitedAt.includes(i)
      ? "invited"
      : suspendedAt.includes(i)
        ? "suspended"
        : "active"
    random() // keep the sequence stable
    const teamCount = random() < 0.35 ? 2 : 1
    const teams = [...teamNames]
      .sort(() => random() - 0.5)
      .slice(0, teamCount)
      .sort()
    const joinedDaysAgo =
      status === "invited"
        ? Math.floor(random() * 10) + 1
        : i === 0
          ? 900
          : Math.floor(random() ** 0.7 * 700) + 14
    return {
      id: `mem-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      name,
      email: name.toLowerCase().replace(" ", ".") + "@example.com",
      role,
      status,
      teams,
      lastActive:
        status === "invited"
          ? null
          : new Date(
              NOW.getTime() -
                (status === "suspended"
                  ? 20 + random() * 60
                  : random() ** 2 * 14) *
                  DAY,
            ),
      // Admins and the owner nearly always have 2FA.
      twoFactor: role === "owner" || role === "admin" ? true : random() < 0.65,
      joinedAt: new Date(NOW.getTime() - joinedDaysAgo * DAY),
    } satisfies Member
  })

  // Owner first, then alphabetical.
  const [owner, ...rest] = people
  return [owner as Member, ...rest.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))]
}

export const members = generateMembers(30, 4417)

/**
 * Niko Table's dropdown-menu primitive: the members of the shadcn
 * `dropdown-menu` Niko Table uses, re-exported under the same names. Niko
 * Table imports them from here, never from `@/components/ui/dropdown-menu`
 * directly, so a base whose component has a different shape (React Aria)
 * swaps only this file.
 */
import type * as React from "react"

import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuRadioGroup,
  DropdownMenuRadioItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu"

/**
 * Marks free-form content (inputs, a command list, a date picker) placed in a
 * menu between its items. Radix renders menu children as-is, so this is a
 * passthrough here; collection-based menus (React Aria) need the marker to
 * render the content instead of dropping it.
 */
function DropdownMenuPanel({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return children
}

export {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuPanel,
  DropdownMenuRadioGroup,
  DropdownMenuRadioItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
}

import {
